what_it_is.one_sentence: A primary-source public record of Canadian federal power — so a citizen can know what government is doing, where money and policy go, and what the multi-year path looks like — guided by LIRIL.
what_it_is.standard: Every claim traces to a primary government or court document. Zero hallucinations. APA-style citations.
what_it_is.aesthetic: QUANTANIUM pristine-ice-lake — crystalline ice over abyssal depth; monochrome chrome; colour only for data severity

journey_A_to_B.A: Visitor lands cold (home, search, share link)
journey_A_to_B.B: Visitor can state: (1) what Ottawa is doing this cycle, (2) which investigation files are active, (3) what the multi-year stated path is, (4) where the primary sources live, (5) how to act under s.504 if relevant
